title: Gauri Shankar Temple Delhi - History, Timings & Travel Guide
content:
Gauri Shankar Temple - Delhi,

Gauri Shankar Temple is one of the oldest and most revered Hindu temples in Delhi, dedicated to Lord Shiva. Located on the busy road of Chandni Chowk, just near the famous Red Fort, the temple is a peaceful spiritual escape in the heart of Old Delhi’s chaos.

The temple is believed to be over 800 years old and houses an 800-year-old brown lingam, encased in a marble structure and surrounded by silver snakes. Devotees also worship the idols of Goddess Parvati (Gauri) and Lord Shiva (Shankar), which is why the temple is named Gauri Shankar.

Special Highlight: The temple becomes especially vibrant during Maha Shivaratri, when thousands of devotees gather here to offer prayers. The chants, lights, and spiritual energy make it an unforgettable experience.

You can visit the Gauri Shankar Temple any time of the year, but the best time is from October to March, when the weather is pleasant for exploring Old Delhi and nearby attractions.

How to Reach Gauri Shankar Temple:

  • Nearest Metro Station: Chandni Chowk (Yellow Line). From there, it’s a short rickshaw ride or walk through the market lanes.
  • By Road: Easily accessible by cabs, autos, and rickshaws. Parking is limited, so public transport is recommended.
  • Nearby Attractions: Red Fort, Fatehpuri Masjid, Jain Lal Mandir, and Khari Baoli Spice Market.

Visitor Information:

  • Timings: Open daily from 5:00 AM to 10:00 PM.
  • Entry Fee: Free for all visitors.
  • Dress Code: Modest clothing is advised when entering the temple.

Travel Tip: Visit early in the morning for peaceful darshan before Chandni Chowk gets crowded.
excerpt: Gauri Shankar Temple in Chandni Chowk, Delhi, is a centuries-old Shiva temple known for its ancient lingam and spiritual atmosphere. A peaceful stop amidst Old Delhi’s chaos, it attracts devotees and travelers alike.

faqs.question: Where is Gauri Shankar Temple located in Delhi?
faqs.answer: Gauri Shankar Temple is located on Chandni Chowk Road in Old Delhi, near Red Fort and Digambar Jain Lal Mandir.

faqs.question: Who built the Gauri Shankar Temple in Delhi?
faqs.answer: The temple is believed to have been built around 800 years ago by a Maratha general named Apa Gangadhar.

faqs.question: What are the timings of Gauri Shankar Temple?
faqs.answer: The temple is open daily from 5:00 AM to 10:00 PM.

faqs.question: Is there any entry fee for Gauri Shankar Temple?
faqs.answer: No, there is no entry fee, and visitors of all faiths are welcome.

faqs.question: Which metro station is near Gauri Shankar Temple?
faqs.answer: The nearest metro station is Chandni Chowk (Yellow Line).
